顧客・用途.quote: ADDiTEC, based in America, develops turnkey directed energy deposition (DED) systems for metal additive manufacturing. Their solutions, including compact wire and powder-based laser systems, enable high-quality metal part production for aerospace, defense, and industrial applications.

Based in France, AMFREE provides turnkey metal additive manufacturing solutions using patented laser-wire DED technology. Their integrated digital workflow—covering CAD/CAM, simulation, and monitoring—ensures high productivity and material quality. Serving industries such as aerospace, defense, and energy, they offer comprehensive support through service centers and material qualification.

Belotti S.p.A., based in Suisio, Italy, specializes in high-performance equipment for 3D printing and CNC machining. Their multi-axis solutions, including milling, waterjet, and ultrasonic cutting systems, serve industries like aerospace, automotive, and marine. Belotti’s advanced technology ensures precision and efficiency for large-scale manufacturing.

Breton, headquartered in Italy, provides turnkey additive and subtractive manufacturing solutions for large-scale industrial applications. Their hybrid manufacturing systems combine precision machining with advanced 3D printing capabilities, catering to aerospace, automotive, and construction industries.

Comau, an Italian robotics company, specializes in advanced automation solutions for manufacturing. Their robotic systems enable high-precision additive manufacturing, improving efficiency in industrial production lines across automotive, aerospace, and heavy industries.

DMG MORI, headquartered in Asia, delivers turnkey hybrid manufacturing systems that integrate CNC machining with additive technologies. Their industrial solutions provide high-precision metal printing and finishing for aerospace, tooling, and medical applications.

Electroimpact, based in America, develops turnkey automated manufacturing systems for aerospace and industrial applications. Their expertise in composite fabrication and additive manufacturing enhances production efficiency for large-scale, high-precision components.

FANUC is a global leader in industrial automation, offering high-precision robotic solutions suitable for 3D printing applications of materials like polymers, metals, and composites. FANUC robots are used in large-scale 3D printing across industries such as aerospace, construction, and automotive, delivering high repeatability and reliability.

Ingersoll, based in America, develops turnkey additive manufacturing solutions for large-scale applications. Their MasterPrint® series enables the production of high-performance composite and metal parts for aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors.

KFM, based in Sweden, specializes in advanced machining and automation solutions for industrial manufacturing. They provide high-precision tools, robotic integration, and custom engineering services to optimize production efficiency. Serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, and heavy machinery, KFM offers tailored solutions that enhance manufacturing capabilities and automation processes.

Panasonic offers robust industrial robotic systems tailored for welding and additive manufacturing. Their robots, combined with DTPS software, ensure precise motion control for processes like Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing. Known for seamless hardware–software integration, Panasonic solutions are ideal for demanding applications in automotive, infrastructure, and heavy industry.

ShopBot, based in America, specializes in CNC and digital fabrication systems, including solutions for additive manufacturing. Their precision-driven machinery supports diverse industries, from aerospace tooling to custom manufacturing applications.

Based in the Czech Republic, TGS provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, from concept to production. They specialize in machining technologies, custom tooling, and automation, with expertise in advanced materials like industrial plastics. TGS also supports sectors like healthcare by developing complete manufacturing processes for medical implants and specialized components.
